title: Vibestep
pitch: Build rhythm game maps in your browser and play them right away.
description: Import a song, find its BPM, then record notes live or edit them on the timeline. Everything stays in your browser, and a built-in CC0 song lets you play with no account or install.

externals.name: YouTube audio via the Windows companion
externals.note: The demo opens with a built-in CC0 song (Bouncer by Of Far Different Nature) and its map. Importing YouTube audio needs the optional Windows companion.
